content.text:
I added the ghost piece and pause to `index.html`; the only check I ran was a syntax check, which passed. Pause keeps the lock ticks and lock resets as they were, and it doesn't restart the gravity timer, so pausing and resuming can't delay a lock.
`getState().ghost` lists all landing cells, but a cell the falling piece covers shows the piece and keeps `data-ghost="false"`; pause does nothing after game over, and the P key also toggles it.
I didn't restart the timer on resume, because that could put off a lock forever.
